checks.name: revision-only change: prior preview becomes a previous reading without a save gate; Preview/Save held; draft kept
explicit read + Continue with my text restores a current preview on the new revision
switching Selected profile to Notes suspends the open dirty editor: late reply is a previous reading, text kept read-only, no Preview/Save/Revert
returning the selection needs an explicit read; Continue with my text resumes with the draft intact
double-click Save: exactly one PUT; saved hash equals the draft
Escape returns to the same Chat with the Composer draft; no Run from preview/save/selection changes
